verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own page states that Copilot code review can analyze pull requests and suggest improvements from the phone, which matches the story almost word for word. Copilot docs add that review feedback includes suggested changes that can be applied with a couple of clicks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Copilot code review on mobile, and detailed mobile docs on requesting reviews and applying suggestions in the app.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent analyze my pull requests and suggest code improvements from my phone

citations.quote: Let Copilot code review analyze your pull requests and suggest improvements right from your phone.
Assign tasks, review code, and collaborate with Copilot from your mobile device
Where possible, Copilot's feedback includes suggested changes which you can apply with a couple of clicks.
